title: really good quality
text: really good quality. Perfect.  I wanted a sturdy, longer spoon to use with my slushie glasses... The stainless I use for my daily use stuff are just not quite long enough or shaped right (small enough) to really stir and grab the slushie stuff at the bottom. So, while these are for iced tea, they work for many things.  The bowl is small... smaller than your usual teaspoon which is perfect for my use.  They are heavy duty and don't feel like they will easily bend, also perfect.  Dishwasher safe.  Stainless.  They arrived in great shape, quickly (I have prime).  I will update if there are any wear or other issues.
